decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: Site location plan; 1096 AL(02)1050 REV 00; 1096 AL(02)1000 REV 01; Energy Statement and Overheating Analysis by FLATT Consulting Ltd dated 29/04/2025; Noise Impact Assessment by KP Acoustic Ltd dated 24/04/2025 (ref:  30000.PCR.01.Rev.B) and Planning Statement by Chiswick Architecture Studio dated April 2025

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - Active cooling shall be restricted to the rooms identified as at risk of overheating within the Energy Statement and Overheating Analysis by FLATT Consulting Ltd dated 29/04/2025, namely, bedrooms 01, 02, 03 & 05.

Reason: To ensure that development reduces the impact of urban and dwelling overheating, including application of the cooling hierarchy, in accordance with policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan.
Condition : 5 - The units installed shall achieve minimum SEER volumes of 5.1 and utilise low global warming potential refrigerants (GWP < 675 or equivalent low-GWP alternatives); the development has reduced cooling demand as far as possible and that the cooling hierarchy has been followed and all feasible measures implemented.

Reason: To ensure that development reduces the impact of urban and dwelling overheating, including application of the cooling hierarchy, in accordance with policy CC2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan.
description: The erection of 2 x external air conditioning units to the rear and side of the existing dwelling house in timber enclosures (retrospective).
